findings.statement: Signed heads were found on 6 of 9 relays queried (8 reachable), covering 35 of 239 chained entries. Heads are the only anchor that catches a consistently rewritten chain, so an entry with no head on any relay a reader queries has no anchor for that reader. This is the finding the operator raised as fixed in a3527263; it is measured, not assumed.
